remaining.title: A per-app CSP response header in firebase.json
remaining.why: That is the portfolio's actual convention (sub-plans and specials-planner both have one there), and a header can enforce script-src 'self' without breaking the axe harness, which a meta tag cannot. firebase.json is outside apps/scan-to-pdf/, so it was out of scope for this pass. The meta CSP I shipped delivers the load-bearing directive (connect-src 'none') today.

remaining.title: Confirming the two add buttons on real Android and iOS hardware
remaining.why: The desktop harness ignores the HTML Media Capture attribute entirely, so I can verify the markup and the layout but not which picker each button opens. The review flagged the same limitation on its own DOM-level check. The change is strictly safer than what was there — one input with capture is now one with and one without.

remaining.title: Edge detection, perspective correction, shadow removal and OCR
remaining.why: Not on the fix list and not deliverable at a sane payload without a dependency, which the brief forbids. Rather than leave them as a gap the user discovers, they are named explicitly in a new 'What this can't do' card, which is what the research asks for.
